description: Na₅InTe₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form distorted NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaTe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaTe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.30-3.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.37 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaTe₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.31-3.53 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaTe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-57°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.25 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one In and five Te atoms. The Na-In bond length is 3.52 Å. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.52 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.09-3.45 Å. In is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and four Te atoms. There are a spread of In-Te bond distances ranging from 2.80-2.86 Å. There are four inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one In atom. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one In atom. In the third Te site, Te is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one In atom. In the fourth Te site, Te is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one In atom.
